summary: Panel component for discrete UI actions, toggles, and momentary triggers. Typically paired with Panel CHOP, callbacks, or custom parameters.

key_params.name: value0
key_params.note: Panel value used by downstream readers

key_params.name: toggle
key_params.note: Use toggle behavior instead of momentary pulse when needed

common_gotchas: A Button COMP is UI state, not a CHOP by itself; use Panel CHOP, callbacks, or exports to drive a network.
Viewer Active must be enabled on the containing panel for direct mouse interaction.
